verdict.rationale: Consensus explicitly markets a REST API (and MCP server) that 'expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app' (consensus-docs-16, consensus-docs-29), covering search, synthesis and automated discovery (consensus-docs-15). However, the docs don't confirm API parity for UI-specific features like Library import/reference management, Threads conversational mode, or Medical Mode, so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for library/reference-manager import, Threads-style conversational sessions, and independent confirmation of full feature parity beyond vendor claims.
